note: INTENTIONAL SAFETY PAUSE — NOT AN OPERATIONAL FAILURE. Postgres became canonical at cutover (database/CUTOVER_STATE.json). The hosted application records suppression in Postgres, but scripts/cron-dispatch.ts reads the committed database/suppression.json, and the ADR-010 publisher that would copy the former into the latter has no executor yet. An opt-out can therefore exist in Postgres without ever reaching the artifact this dispatcher checks, so automated dispatch could email someone who has asked not to be contacted. Automated dispatch stays paused until that publisher exists and has run. Suppression synchronisation DOES NOT exist today. To resume: set paused=false here AND restore the schedule block in .github/workflows/outreach-dispatch.yml. Do neither until suppression actually publishes. See docs/adr/ADR-018-legacy-json-writes-frozen-after-cutover.md and docs/adr/ADR-010-one-way-suppression-publish.md.
unblockedBy: an active, verified Postgres -> database/suppression.json publisher (ADR-010)
